description: At a Rome amusement park in 1962, Nora and Rosa begin untangling a family mystery that crosses class, politics and memories of the war, while the people around them discover that old secrets are much easier to preserve before two determined young women compare notes.

s01e01.description: Wealthy Rosa visits Nora, a young fortune-teller at the amusement park, and the reading revives her belief that the twin sister lost in childhood may still be alive. Small coincidences around the park make that possibility suddenly much less abstract.

s01e02.description: Rosa's affluent family hosts the communist parents of Matteo and Simone, turning dinner into a collision of politics, class and barely concealed resentment. At the park, Nora presses her grandmother Miranda about inconsistencies in the story of her own childhood.

s01e03.description: Nora tells Rosa what she has discovered and insists that the secret remain between them while they try to understand what connects their families. Elsewhere, Simone follows his suspicions about Sandro and becomes increasingly convinced that something criminal lies beneath the respectable surface.

s01e04.description: Determined to stop living on fragments and evasions, Nora forces Miranda to explain how she came into the family during the war. The account exposes the origin of a secret that has shaped both households for years without either younger woman understanding why.

s01e05.description: With Nora beside him, Simone must decide whether to act on what he believes he has learned about Sandro. Back at the amusement park, Ettore surprises Antonio with the ride he has always wanted, a generous gesture that leaves Miranda considerably less delighted than the recipient.

s01e06.description: After informing on Sandro, Simone is forced to run and Nora helps him stay ahead of the consequences. At the same time Tullio struggles to keep old family secrets contained, while Lucia's instincts push her toward answers that are becoming increasingly difficult to hide.
